**Finding: Missing (critical) — no IP/data ownership provision.**

The Agreement is entirely silent on ownership. HDI designs, develops, hosts and maintains the Site at its own cost (§§1.1–1.3), holds our Content (§2.1), our "Deerskin" Marks (§6.1) and our customer e-mail lists (§7.1) — but nothing states who owns the Site and other work product, our Content, or the visitor/purchaser data generated through the Site. Section 10.2's "co-ownership" disclaimer is a partnership carve-out only, not an IP allocation, and there is no licence-back covering HDI software or administration tools embedded in the Site we pay for through the Net Sales share and Termination Payment.

**Redline (validated, inserted as new §5.5 after §5.4):** Company owns the Content, Marks, customer lists and all Site visitor/purchaser data, with no assignment to HDI; HDI assigns the Site and all deliverables/work product to the Company; HDI retains its pre-existing platform, tools and know-how and grants us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense anything embedded in the Deliverables; no joint ownership.

Fallback if HDI resists the assignment: it keeps its generic tools and know-how provided we hold the perpetual, sublicensable licence over the Deliverables.
